import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
df['촉매그룹'] = df['촉매로트'].apply(lambda x: 'old' if x in ['FC-2602', 'FC-2603', 'FC-2604', 'FC-2605'] else 'new')
bins = list(np.arange(2.5, 6.7501, 0.25))
df['bin_idx'] = pd.cut(df['체류시간 (s)'], bins=bins, right=False, labels=[(b + e)/2 for b, e in zip(bins[:-1], bins[1:])])
grp = df.groupby(['촉매그룹', 'bin_idx']).agg(cnt=('CNT수율 (g/g-cat)', 'size'), mean_y=('CNT수율 (g/g-cat)', 'mean')).reset_index()
grp = grp[grp['cnt'] >= 10]
df_new = grp[['촉매그룹', 'bin_idx', 'mean_y']].copy()
df_new.columns = ['촉매그룹', '체류시간_bin_mid', 'CNT수율_mean']
df_new['체류시간_bin_mid'] = pd.to_numeric(df_new['체류시간_bin_mid'])
df_new['CNT수율_mean'] = pd.to_numeric(df_new['CNT수율_mean'])
df = df_new.sort_values('체류시간_bin_mid')
